long_biography.plain_text:
Kulczyk Investments has moved from inherited industrial holdings towards a two-part portfolio: established dividend businesses and younger companies selected for growth. Under Sebastian Kulczyk's ownership, the group took chemicals producer Ciech private as Qemetica, retained interests in gold mining, real estate and technology, and refocused new investment on medium-sized European companies.

Kulczyk entered the family business through strategic projects in African resources before becoming chief executive in 2014. After he and his sister divided their inherited assets, he assumed control of the investment house, Ciech and the family motorway interests. He later moved to chair the supervisory board, giving professional executives day-to-day authority while retaining ownership and strategic direction.
